//: EVERYTHING emits, the gui panel included. A gui component's style props are named by the gui CONFIG, and a package that ships .tsx makes the consumer compile it against whatever config the consumer registered — so the same source is correct in one app and 14 errors in the next. Emitting declarations settles the names here, once, against the config in gui.config.ts, and a consumer reads a .d.ts like any other package.
